record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace strict unit normalization in the tied item embedding with e/max(||e||_2,1e-12)^0.9 for both history and candidate lookups, keeping padding zero. Retaining a small amount of jointly learned item magnitude may improve representation flexibility without adding parameters or a separate scorer. Preserve dimensions, GRU topology, features, history, readout, scoring formula, loss and optimizer; synchronize predictor loading.
